={{ `INSERT INTO workspace.agentic_support.refunds (
  refund_id, order_id, return_id, refund_type, amount, currency,
  method, status, route, approved_by, created_at
)
SELECT
  '${String($json.refund_id ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''")}',
  o.order_id,
  ${$json.return_id ? `'${String($json.return_id).replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'NULL'},
  CASE WHEN '${String($json.request_type ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''")}' = 'return_refund' THEN 'return'
       ELSE '${String($json.request_type ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''")}' END,
  CAST(${Math.max(0, Number($json.amount ?? $json.refund_amount ?? 0))} AS DECIMAL(18,2)),
  o.currency,
  '${String($json.method ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''")}',
  '${String($json.status ?? 'rejected').replace(/'/g, "''")}',
  '${String($json.route ?? 'decline').replace(/'/g, "''")}',
  NULLIF('${String($json.approved_by ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''")}', ''),
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
FROM workspace.agentic_support.orders o
WHERE o.order_id = '${String($json.order_id ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''")}'
  AND '${String($json.refund_id ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''")}' <> ''
  AND LENGTH('${String($json.refund_id ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''")}') <= 10` }}

parameters.query:
={{ `WITH cfg AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN config_key='as_of_date' THEN CAST(config_value AS DATE) END) AS as_of_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN config_key='risk_score_escalate' THEN CAST(config_value AS INT) END) AS risk_score_escalate,
    MAX(CASE WHEN config_key='serial_refund_threshold' THEN CAST(config_value AS INT) END) AS serial_refund_threshold,
    MAX(CASE WHEN config_key='damage_report_days' THEN CAST(config_value AS INT) END) AS damage_report_days
  FROM workspace.agentic_support.config
),
latest_return AS (
  SELECT return_id, order_id, reason_code, reason_text, resolution, status AS return_status,
         refund_amount AS return_refund_amount, currency AS return_currency, created_at,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY created_at DESC, return_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM workspace.agentic_support.returns
),
return_counts AS (
  SELECT order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT return_id) AS return_count
  FROM workspace.agentic_support.returns
  GROUP BY order_id
),
refund_counts AS (
  SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS refund_count
  FROM workspace.agentic_support.refunds
  WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(status, '')) IN ('initiated', 'completed', 'processed', 'success')
  GROUP BY order_id
),
latest_inspection AS (
  SELECT inspection_id, return_id, order_id, customer_id, kind AS inspection_kind,
         status AS inspection_status, note AS inspection_note, inspector,
         created_at AS inspection_created_at, completed_at AS inspection_completed_at,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY return_id ORDER BY created_at DESC, inspection_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM workspace.agentic_support.inspections
),
auto_actions AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id, COUNT(*) AS auto_actions_30d
  FROM workspace.agentic_support.audit_log a
  CROSS JOIN cfg c
  WHERE a.route='auto'
    AND a.decision='Executed'
    AND a.event_time >= CAST(c.as_of_date - INTERVAL 30 DAYS AS TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY a.customer_id
)
SELECT
  o.order_id,
  o.customer_id,
  o.country,
  o.currency,
  o.amount,
  o.shipping_fee,
  o.payment_method,
  o.status AS order_status,
  o.refunded,
  CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(o.refunded, 'no')) = 'yes' OR COALESCE(fc.refund_count, 0) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_existing_refund,
  s.status AS ship_status,
  s.estimated_delivery,
  s.delivered_date,
  s.claim_status,
  DATEDIFF(c.as_of_date, s.delivered_date) AS days_since_delivery,
  CASE
    WHEN s.status='delivered' THEN 0
    WHEN s.estimated_delivery IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE GREATEST(0, DATEDIFF(c.as_of_date, s.estimated_delivery))
  END AS days_late,
  p.return_window_days,
  p.delay_threshold_days,
  p.auto_limit,
  p.approval_limit,
  p.max_auto_actions_30d,
  p.refund_method,
  p.version AS policy_version,
  COALESCE(rc.return_count, 0) AS return_count,
  COALESCE(fc.refund_count, 0) AS refund_count,
  lr.return_id AS latest_return_id,
  lr.reason_code AS latest_return_reason_code,
  lr.reason_text AS latest_return_reason_text,
  lr.resolution AS latest_return_resolution,
  lr.return_status,
  lr.return_refund_amount,
  lr.return_currency,
  li.inspection_id AS latest_inspection_id,
  li.inspection_kind,
  li.inspection_status,
  li.inspection_note,
  li.inspector,
  li.inspection_created_at,
  li.inspection_completed_at,
  COALESCE(aa.auto_actions_30d, 0) AS auto_actions_30d,
  c.risk_score_escalate,
  c.serial_refund_threshold,
  c.damage_report_days
FROM workspace.agentic_support.orders o
LEFT JOIN workspace.agentic_support.shipments s
  ON s.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN workspace.agentic_support.policies p
  ON p.country = o.country AND p.currency = o.currency
CROSS JOIN cfg c
LEFT JOIN latest_return lr
  ON lr.order_id = o.order_id AND lr.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN return_counts rc
  ON rc.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN refund_counts fc
  ON fc.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN latest_inspection li
  ON li.return_id = lr.return_id AND li.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN auto_actions aa
  ON aa.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_id='${String($json.order_id ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''")}'
  AND o.customer_id='${String($json.customer_id ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''")}'` }}
